summary: Clean on the MEM dimension. All three modules return plain scalars (intp/int32) or void, hold no NRT/meminfo objects, and cross no @cfunc boundary, so there are no refcount, leak, or exception-swallow surfaces. Symbol resolution uses extern declarations (get_or_insert_function / external GlobalVariable) rather than literal addresses, keeping cache=True correct under ASLR; per-platform symbol selection, errno-pointer alignment, the size_t/intp argument widths, and the deliberate non-readnone errno-accessor declaration are all correct.
